posts.text: Ceinsys Tech has informed NSE that it is now a Google Cloud Partner for Co-sell, Services and Technology, including Google Workspace. This can help Ceinsys get more Cloud, AI, data and digital projects and reach bigger customers. At P/E 12.8, the valuation looks reasonable, and the stock is near its Median Market Cap/Sales of 2.7. The key opportunity is Google’s co-sell ecosystem, which could help Ceinsys win larger enterprise and government customers.
